packageRules.description: typescript is held on the last major carrying the JavaScript compiler API, below the first release typescript-eslint's typescript peer range excludes, because typescript-eslint reads types through that API and the native compiler lacks it. This rule and the @typescript/native alias go once typescript-eslint supports the native compiler: https://typescript-eslint.io/users/dependency-versions
